decisions: One shared kit per platform (spec section 10): iOS FSForm* in FellowScript/FellowScript/Theme or Shared; web Form* components plus one shared token file read by antd ConfigProvider (theme.js) and global.css.
Kit first, then migrate in batches by feature area so each batch is reviewable and testable; commit per batch.
Tokens: iOS reuses Theme.cardGlassGray/borderGray and system fonts; web remaps gold to #D4922A family per spec 11.1 and adds box tokens.
Sensitive (S) forms get a security gate after migration: autofill/secure-entry/disclaimer attributes must be unchanged.

Entries overlapping group-info-row (F-029..034, F-037..039, F-041..048, F-049, F-065, F-067, F-068) are the last batch, blocked until that branch merges and forms-restyle is rebased; reported to Jacey, not skipped silently.
iOS simulator tests run one at a time. No push or deploy.

steps.name: Kit API and token mapping: component list, props, file layout, parity-test impact (iOS + web)

Build shared kits and tokens: iOS FSForm* (scaffold, section, field, toggle row, chips, segmented, radio list, number stepper, rail, pinned bar, error card, destructive confirm); web Form* kit, sticky footer, shared token file, antd theme remap
Kit tests and build: iOS build + kit unit tests, web vitest
Batch A migrate: Auth C/H (F-001..008), Account D/B/G (F-009..022), Billing and payouts (F-023..027)
Security review of batch A and all S forms: autofill, secure entry, disclaimers, reveal/re-mask, no sensitive data in logs

Batch B migrate: non-overlap Groups (F-028, F-035, F-036, F-040), Sessions/devotion/rooms (F-050..F-056), Notes (F-057..064), Reporting (F-070, F-071), Misc (F-093), Explore (F-072..078), Admin (F-079..088)
Design conformance review of A and B against mockups and spec Revision 2 (fonts, boxes, no Inter/Playfair in forms)
Batch B tests, full web suite, full iOS test run (serial)
Batch C migrate: group-info-row overlap entries (O list)
steps.checkpoint: group-info-row merged into ios-build-2-9-9 and forms-restyle rebased; testing step 9 passed

steps.name: Final conformance review and tests for batch C and whole branch
